recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下紅系前驅細胞體積偏大、染色質呈細點狀開放（megaloblastoid change），且細胞核與細胞質成熟度不一致，屬於紅系發育不良，是 RCC 抹片中常見的線索。
features: Enlarged erythroid precursors with open, finely stippled (megaloblastoid) chromatin
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: nuclei immature relative to more hemoglobinized cytoplasm in some cells
Several large cells with deeply basophilic or gray-blue cytoplasm and round nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors, including a cell with granular cytoplasm and a bilobed/band-like nucleus
No convincing increase in blasts in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows erythroid precursors that are enlarged, with finely stippled, open chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, consistent with megaloblastoid change. Admixed granulocytic precursors show maturation without obvious excess of blasts in this field. Findings indicate dyserythropoiesis; in a child with persistent cytopenia and less than 2% blasts in blood and less than 5% in marrow, this supports refractory cytopenia of childhood after exclusion of nutritional and inherited causes.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia also shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils and is excluded by normal vitamin levels, rather than morphology alone.
Parvovirus produces giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions and a paucity of maturing erythroid forms rather than megaloblastoid change across stages.
CDA shows striking binucleation or internuclear bridging confined to the erythroid lineage with isolated anemia, not multilineage cytopenias.
